maddeler.e:
يعتصما (form VIII)
# يَعْتَصِمَا (yaʕtaṣimā) /jaʕ.ta.sˤi.maː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَصَمَ (iʕtaṣama)
# يُعْتَصَمَا (yuʕtaṣamā) /juʕ.ta.sˤa.maː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَصَمَ (iʕtaṣama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
